name: browser-mcp
description: Chrome extension + local MCP server exposing browser operations via code-mcp-gateway

scripts.icons: cd packages/browser-extension/icons && for s in 16 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s -o app-icon-$s.png mcp-gray.svg; rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s -o connected-$s.png mcp-green.svg; done
